subject: Venue technical criteria + streaming onboarding kit for Redwood exec workshop
messages:
From: Evan Gallagher <evan@grandnorthvenues.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Venue technical criteria + streaming onboarding kit for Redwood exec workshop

Hi Priya,

Thanks for considering Grand North for the April 26th Redwood executive workshop. I pulled together our initial technical checklist and a first-draft floorplan for Level 2 (attached). Before we lock rooms I want to confirm a few items that impact your AV scope and the external stream setup: 

- Primary room: built-in Cisco SX80 codec with dual HDMI inputs; native SIP/H.323 support to your bridge. We can provide a redundant SRT ingest if you prefer a cloud-friendly fallback.
- House internet: 2x 10Gbps uplinks with BGP; we can reserve a /29 for event gear.
- Camera count: Up to 3 PTZ camera feeds (center stage, wide, audience).
- Audio: Dante-enabled FOH; we can provide analog feed, AES67, or Dante stream to your encoder.
- Staging: Front-of-house space for a roaming producer and one hardware encoder rack.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Do you require continuity for live demos (low-latency, <150ms) rather than webinar-style keyframe buffering?
2) Are you expecting remote execs to dial in via our bridge (SIP) or do you want us to stream to Zoom Live/YouTube with a managed moderator feed?
3) Will the Redwood team bring a hardware encoder (Teradek/Ronin) or do you want OneStream AV to provide a managed encoder and redundancy?

I copied Karthik and Monica to align on network and onsite provisioning. Attachments: GNV-Floorplan-Level2.pdf and the draft Scope-of-Work.

If it helps, Bethany from OneStream AV can join a 30-min call tomorrow to talk ingest and redundancy. Are you available 10:30–11:00am PT?

Regards,
Evan Gallagher
Director, Technical Events
Grand North Venues
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0118

--
Attachments: GNV-Floorplan-Level2.pdf, AV_SOW_Redwood_v2.pdf
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Evan Gallagher <evan@grandnorthvenues.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Venue technical criteria + streaming onboarding kit for Redwood exec workshop

Evan — thanks for the quick turnaround and the floorplan. This looks promising. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

- Latency: we need low-latency for a live demo segment (approx 8 minutes) where we will do an interactive Q&A between onstage execs and remote product engineers. Target end-to-end <200ms where possible; if not feasible we’ll accept up to 350ms for the non-demo segments.
- Bridge: prefer direct SIP into our dedicated Redwood meeting bridge (we’ll provide credentials). For wider-watch audiences we’ll also publish an HLS stream to our private YouTube staging link; so we need both a SIP endpoint and an encoded HLS output.
- Encoder: Redwood will not ship a hardware encoder. Please coordinate with OneStream AV to provision a primary encoder with an independent backup (SRT ingest + cloud relay) and clear failover steps in the SOW.

Can you confirm that the Dante outputs can be looped to the encoder with separate left/right channels for recording? Also confirm we can stage a small network switch with an isolated VLAN for Redwood gear (we will consume a reserved IP range).

10:30am PT tomorrow works for a short sync. Please loop in Bethany and a member of your NOC.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Program Manager, Events Operations
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0233
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Evan Gallagher <evan@grandnorthvenues.com>, OneStream AV - Bethany Ruiz <bethany@onestreamav.com>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Venue technical criteria + streaming onboarding kit for Redwood exec workshop

Evan/Bethany — adding network and security requirements from our side: 

- We require an isolated VLAN and DHCP scope for Redwood devices; we will supply a /29 on the event VLAN and a pre-approved list of MAC addresses 48hrs before load-in.
- Egress firewall rules: allow outbound 443, 80, 1935 (RTMP), and 5004/5005 for RTP where needed. If you enforce outbound restrictions, please add our NOC IP ranges (we will provide).
- Recording and retention: session recordings will be uploaded to Redwood GCS; please confirm S3/GCS integration support for OneStream upload.
- Test window: we need a 2-hour dry run two days prior with both SRT fallback and SIP calls to our bridge. Please include that in the SOW timeline.

Monica Patel
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Bethany Ruiz <bethany@onestreamav.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, evan@grandnorthvenues.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Venue technical criteria + streaming onboarding kit for Redwood exec workshop

Hi all — Bethany here from OneStream AV. Short summary of what we’ll deliver and a couple of clarifying Qs: 

Deliverables (tentative, will finalize in SOW):
- Primary hardware encoder (Teradek Cube 655) + redundant encoder (software + cloud relay), pre-staged and tested.
- Managed SIP registration to Redwood bridge + operator console to manage participant pins and dial-outs.
- Redundant ingest: primary RTMP/HLS plus SRT fallback to one of our cloud relays.
- Local recording (ISO/room) plus consolidated master that we can push to your GCS bucket.

Questions:
1) For the low-latency demo, are you planning to use native VP9/AV1 or H.264? AV1 reduces bandwidth but encoder latency may increase.
2) Please confirm the maximum concurrent remote participants you need on the SIP bridge (operator counts tokens).

We’ll include the 2-hour dry run slot in the SOW and a NOC on-call contact. I attached a streaming redundancy diagram and our provisional SOW. Happy to finalize on the call tomorrow at 10:30am PT.

Best,
Bethany Ruiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, OneStream AV
bethany@onestreamav.com
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Ruiz <bethany@onestreamav.com>, Evan Gallagher <evan@grandnorthvenues.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Venue technical criteria + streaming onboarding kit for Redwood exec workshop

Thanks Bethany — that scope aligns with Redwood needs. Quick decisions for SOW final: 

- Codec: we'll do H.264 for the live demo to prioritize encoder predictability; record masters may be encoded in AV1 for archival if bandwidth permits.
- SIP capacity: cap the bridge to 60 concurrent SIP endpoints for the event.
- Dry run: schedule for April 24th 09:00–11:00 PT. Please confirm calendar invites and send the pre-check checklist 72 hours prior.
- Action: Evan/Bethany — update SOW to list NOC contact, exact IP ranges for the reserved VLAN, and a step-by-step failover play (SIP -> SRT relay -> cloud re-encode).

Naomi, looping you to coordinate travel and load-in windows for Redwood AV techs (we’ll need two techs on-site from 06:00 load-in).

I’ll sign off on the SOW once the NOC contact and IP ranges are included.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Program Manager, Events Operations
Redwood Inference
